name: tilt
description: Tilt: play blackjack, roulette, baccarat and slots in a pane while your agent works. Reads only turn start/end events.

apiUrl.title: Tilt API URL
apiUrl.description: Base URL of the Tilt API. Change it only for local development, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080.

layout.title: Tilt layout
layout.description: side: a pane beside the transcript in fullscreen, under it otherwise. bottom: the whole table above the prompt. compact: two lines above the prompt. Preview them with /tilt setup.

cards.title: Tilt cards
cards.description: large: the five-row cards, small ones where they would not fit. small: one row per card.

autoOpen.title: Open Tilt when the agent starts
autoOpen.description: Open the pane (or fill the band) when a turn starts, without taking the keyboard.

sound.title: Tilt sounds
sound.description: A short sound when cards are dealt and when you win. Off by default.
